name: set_glob_options
description: Set a glob's options: dot (wildcards match dotfiles) and nocase.

name: add_glob
description: Add a glob; it gets the next free id (g1, g2, …).

name: reorder_globs
description: Move a glob to a position (0 is first).

name: set_paths
description: Replace the paths: one string, one path per line.

name: set_expectation
description: Say whether a glob should match a path: match, no-match, or none to clear it.

name: matches
description: The paths a glob matches and doesn't, and each of its expectations with pass or fail.

name: explain
description: The regex picomatch compiles a glob to, with its base directory and whether it is a glob at all.
